1.mascotDialogue: All the splitting, tesoro, is just bookkeeping — the real sorting happens entirely in the merge step, comparing two already-sorted halves and interleaving them correctly!

2.mascotDialogue: Lines 9 and 10 are the merge's heart — compare the fronts of both halves, take the smaller, advance only that side. Lines 12 and 13 mop up whichever half still has leftovers once the other runs dry.

3.mascotDialogue: This view shows no swaps at all — merge sort does not swap in place, she writes the smaller of two fronts into a fresh position, with every comparison.

4.mascotDialogue: It is easy to think the merge is finished the moment the main comparison loop ends — but one side almost always finishes before the other, and forgetting to drain the leftovers loses real data, quietly.
